items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This update resolves a critical unauthenticated arbitrary code execution vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) that is being actively exploited in the wild. Attackers can inject malicious code into Magento's template system to achieve remote code execution and plant backdoors.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses multiple critical vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated privilege escalation flaw (CVSS 9.1) that allows attackers to switch customer sessions and gain access to victim accounts. It also includes other critical vulnerabilities related to cross-site scripting and authorization bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Part of the APSB26-92 bulletin, this critical vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) is a Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) flaw that could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability (CVSS 7.7), addressed in APSB26-92, could result in arbitrary code execution. Authentication is required for exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) in the webhooks component allows unauthenticated, zero-interaction arbitrary code execution. It is considered one of the most severe bugs to hit Magento and Adobe Commerce.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Addressed in APSB26-73, this critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) is an unrestricted file upload flaw that allows attackers to plant malicious files on the server, potentially leading to code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical Stored XSS vulnerability, part of APSB26-73, could lead to privilege escalation via scripts injected into the admin backend.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability, rated critical in APSB26-73, allows for security feature bypass by circumventing default system rules.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability, detailed in APSB26-73, could lead to unauthorized access to resources.
